raw_text: Alt News has verified that the viral DD News curfew broadcast is a deepfake video created using AI. The news anchor is entirely AI-generated — facial analysis shows no match in any Indian broadcast database. The video uses authentic DD News branding but with subtle errors in logo placement and font sizing. Doordarshan has confirmed no such broadcast was ever aired. This is a dangerous case of AI-generated misinformation designed to create public panic.
